subject: POC plan & success criteria for VertiScribe (post-demo follow-up)
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Martin <elena.martin@vertiscribe.ai>, Carlos Mejia <carlos@vertiscribe.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-04-09T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: POC plan & success criteria for VertiScribe (post-demo follow-up)

Hi Elena / Carlos —

Thanks again for the time today — the demo was great and your product team did a solid job outlining the transcription + summarization flows that matter most. Quick recap and proposed POC plan so we can lock the kickoff: 

POC objective (30 days): validate that Redwood can serve VertiScribe's user workflows with parity to your current stack while reducing per-minute inference cost and meeting latency/quality targets for EN/ES/FR.

Proposed success criteria (we put a draft in the attached spreadsheet):
- Functional: generated summaries match current business rules for 95% of sampled calls (see eval set columns).
- Quality: intent/slot extraction accuracy >= 92% on the 500-call eval subset across EN/ES/FR.
- Latency: 95th percentile tail latency <= 350ms per generation request in the hosted trial environment for single-call summary flows.
- Throughput: sustain 50 concurrent single-user sessions with median latency < 200ms when batching enabled.
- Safety/regression: no critical safety regressions on flagged prompt suite; fewer than 3% hallucination events on the eval set.

Model roster (trial selection & fallbacks):
- Primary model: Llama-3 34B (quantized q4f16) — chosen for conversational summarization fidelity.
- Fallback model: Mistral-Instruct 7B (fp16) — for lower-latency, lower-cost flows and for quick A/B comparisons.
- Multilingual: use Llama-3 34B as canonical multilingual model; add small localized prompt templates for ES/FR in the eval set.

Ownership & timelines:
- Kickoff/requirements call: target Apr 16, 2028 — confirm availability.
- Redwood technical lead: Aditya Rao (cc'd).
- Customer PM: Elena.
- SOW + evaluation artefacts: we'll drop an SOW draft + evaluation CSV in Drive; I attached the baseline success metrics XLSX.

Next steps / asks for you:
1) Confirm that the evaluation subset (sample IDs) in sample_prompts_and_evalset.csv is representative (especially Spanish examples).
2) Confirm any data residency or network requirements (you mentioned SOC2 compliance earlier).
3) Approve the kickoff date or propose alternatives.

If that looks good I can have Ben and Aditya spin up a dedicated trial environment and provide a short runbook for running the eval harness.

Thanks — talk soon,

Sofia Ivanova
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: POC-success-metrics.xlsx; sample_prompts_and_evalset.csv; SOW-draft-VertiScribe.pdf
From: Elena Martin <elena.martin@vertiscribe.ai>

Date: 2028-04-09T17:32:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC plan & success criteria for VertiScribe (post-demo follow-up)

Sofia —

Appreciate the clear recap. High level looks good and we like the two-tier model approach. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Eval set: Carlos will validate the sample IDs and flag additional Spanish examples (we have dialectal variance across LATAM that matters).
- Data residency: we need logs retained in US only for the trial; we also require that the trial environment supports KMS-managed keys for any persisted artifacts. Can you confirm?
- Security docs: can you send SOC2 + encryption-in-transit details? We'll need to share those with procurement.

Regarding the success thresholds — the 95% functional match is aggressive but reasonable for the sampled slice. If we hit 90% we'll consider the trial a partial success if latency and throughput targets are met.

Kickoff: Apr 16th works for us, morning PST. Please schedule an initial 60-minute session to walk through eval harness and data upload.

Thanks,
Elena
Elena Martin
Head of Product | VertiScribe
elena.martin@vertiscribe.ai
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>

Date: 2028-04-10T08:14:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC plan & success criteria for VertiScribe (post-demo follow-up)

Elena / Sofia —

Thanks — confirming a few implementation notes from Redwood: 

1) Environment & keys: we will provision a dedicated trial cluster in the us-west-2 region for this POC and can enable customer-managed KMS keys for any persisted artifacts. I'll loop in our security team to provide the SOC2 + encryption details; expect an email with the security package by EOD Apr 11.

2) Technical owners & runbook: Aditya will be the tech lead; his scope includes running the eval harness, validating latency/throughput under load, and coordinating the model switch tests (Llama-3 -> Mistral 7B). Aditya — can you prepare a short checklist for the kickoff session (data upload format, tokenization notes, batching knobs we recommend)?

3) Timeline and milestones (proposed):
- Apr 16: kickoff + data handoff + runbook walkthrough.
- Apr 17-20: ingest & precompute KV caches; baseline runs (sanity checks).
- Apr 21-28: evaluation runs (quality + latency sweeps); compare Llama-3 vs Mistral.
- Apr 29: interim review call to share metrics.
- May 2: final acceptance window / follow-on pricing conversation.

4) Acceptance criteria flexibility: noted — we'll treat >=90% functional match as "conditional success" if infra SLAs are comfortably met.

I'll attach a short SOW draft to the Drive folder and ping procurement for the KMS onboarding steps.

-Ben

Quick note — thanks team. I'll pack the kickoff checklist into the Drive folder this afternoon. High-level items I'll cover:
- Data ingestion template + sample ingestion script (CSV + gzipped audio pointers).
- Tokenization & prompt templates for EN/ES/FR (we'll include locale-specific prompt examples to reduce hallucinations).
- Recommended quantization profile for Llama-3 34B (q4f16) and fallback config for Mistral 7B.
- Load test harness: how to reproduce the 50 concurrent sessions and where to find the benchmark script.

Also: security note — we'll use ephemeral KV caches during evaluation and scrub any persisted caches after the trial unless you request retention.

See you on Apr 16th (morning PST).
